scenes.title: switchboard
scenes.subtitle: Durable mail, work queues and locks for AI agents on different machines

scenes.title: Agents on two machines need to talk
bullets: Sean's agents and Tony's agents hand each other work: reviews, tests, merges
The old hub (Python agent-mail) mostly worked, but:
anyone past the tunnel could act as anyone; a crashed agent stranded its task forever
the merge lock never expired; peers stayed disconnected after a hub restart
switchboard: one Rust binary, leases, scoped tokens, fenced locks, one-command onboarding

scenes.title: How it fits together
scenes.caption: One hub keeps the mail in SQLite. Everyone else joins over tailcat (WireGuard, no accounts).

steps.text: switchboard watch
switchboard --as sean/coord send tony/merge "PR 41 (gunner seats) is gated: please merge it" --subject "merge PR 41"
steps.output: sent #2 to tony/merge

steps.text:
#2 0s ago sean/coord -> tony/merge [open]  merge PR 41
    PR 41 (gunner seats) is gated: please merge it
take claims it under a 15-minute lease, so no other agent can start the same job.
switchboard --as tony/merge take
steps.output:
#2 0s ago sean/coord -> tony/merge [leased by tony/merge, 14m left]  merge PR 41
    PR 41 (gunner seats) is gated: please merge it

steps.text: done with a note closes it, and the note goes back to the sender as a reply.
switchboard --as tony/merge done 2 --note "merged as 6ce7623, main is green"
steps.output: #2 done (reply sent)

steps.output:

steps.text: The agent's answer came back to Sean as a threaded reply.
switchboard --as sean/coord inbox
steps.output:
#1 23s ago switchboard -> sean [open]  tony joined
    tony joined the switchboard from tailcat key nodekey:a7fa7866f9d57ad606d455da8b35e4b5e25f41482536922bb2286dbfb48f5271. Say hi: `switchboard send tony "hello"`.

#5 3s ago tony/codex -> sean/coord [open] re #4  re: rust question
    Yes—holding a std::sync::MutexGuard across .await makes the enclosing future !Send because MutexGuard is !Send and must be retained across the suspension point.

scenes.caption: Coding agents get the queue as native MCP tools: take, done, send, wait_for_mail, lock_take…

steps.text: switchboard send tony "rebuild the Windows package and run the smoke test"
steps.output: sent #6 to tony

steps.text: switchboard --as tony/a take --lease 5s
steps.output:
#6 0s ago sean -> tony [leased by tony/a, 4s left]
    rebuild the Windows package and run the smoke test

steps.text: tony/a dies here without finishing. Five seconds later its lease runs out…
switchboard --as tony/b take
steps.output:
#6 6s ago sean -> tony [leased by tony/b, 14m left]
    rebuild the Windows package and run the smoke test

steps.text: …so tony/b picks it up. After five lapses a message goes to the dead-letter list, and the sender is told.

scenes.caption: If an agent crashes mid-task, its lease runs out and the task goes back in the queue.

steps.text: switchboard lock take feat/gunner-seats --ttl 15s
steps.output: lock main: yours, fence 1. Before acting: `switchboard lock check 1`. Then `switchboard lock release`.

steps.text: switchboard --as tony/merge lock take tony/boats --wait
steps.output:
lock main: held by sean since 0s ago, fence 1, expires in 14s (feat/gunner-seats); waiting: tony/merge -- waiting
lock main: held by sean since 5s ago, fence 1, expires in 9s (feat/gunner-seats); waiting: tony/merge -- waiting
lock main: held by sean since 10s ago, fence 1, expires in 4s (feat/gunner-seats); waiting: tony/merge -- waiting
lock main: yours, fence 2. Before acting: `switchboard lock check 2`. Then `switchboard lock release`.

steps.text: Sean's lane stalled and never renewed, so its lease ran out and Tony's waiting lane got the lock.
Before pushing, Sean's lane checks its fence. It's stale, so the push is refused.
switchboard lock check 1 && git push origin HEAD:main
steps.output: INVALID: fence 1 does not hold lock main. lock main: held by tony/merge since 0s ago, fence 2, expires in 9m (tony/boats)

steps.text: switchboard --as tony/merge lock release --note "pushed 1a2b3c4"
steps.output: lock main: released; watchers were told

scenes.caption: Locks such as "one lane pushes main at a time" expire, and every grant gets a higher fence number.

scenes.title: What you get
bullets: Scoped tokens: tony may act as tony/* only; force-release and invites are admin-only
Leases, requeue and dead letters: a crashed agent never strands work
Expiring locks with fencing: a stale holder can't push
Server-side watch cursors, idempotent sends, broadcasts with per-agent acks
launchd/systemd service, disk-space guard, daily backups, self-healing tunnels, a doctor command
MCP tools and a skill for Claude Code and Codex, registered by setup/join
